audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of Lewis and Marnie’s secret relationship, the Joja completion ceremony, and Emily rescuing an injured parrot. Every spoken line, player response, relationship statement, corporate parody, civic-project term, town name, animal-care statement, and narration was reviewed in full event context against the canonical Ukrainian glossary. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, response IDs, completion conditions, item reward, placeholders, gender branches, dialogue delimiters, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and all non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. Remaining Town records and full-locale final audits remain pending.
